preconditions.description: The number of time-steps n is between 1 and 200 inclusive.
The number of bananas m is between 2 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 2 for t_i, _, _ in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation type t_i is either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y_i <= m for _, _, y_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each y_i is between 1 and m inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_i <= 10**5 * m if t_i == 1 else 10**5 < x_i <= 10**5 * m for t_i, x_i, _ in operations)
preconditions.description: Each x_i is within the specified range based on the operation type t_i.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly m integers.

postconditions.expression: all(result[j-1] == -1 or 1 <= result[j-1] <= n for j in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: Each output value is either -1 or a time-step between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(result[j-1] == -1 or can_create_exactly_j_bananas(j, operations, result[j-1]) for j in range(1, m+1))
postconditions.description: If the output value for j is not -1, it is the earliest time-step at which exactly j bananas can be created.
